title: The Invisible Gorilla attention test (Hindi audio, English captions)
sources: APA Monitor, 'Sights unseen' (April 2001): https://www.apa.org/monitor/apr01/blindness (Simons & Chabris 1999; viewers counted one team's passes; person in a gorilla suit walked in, faced the camera, thumped chest, on screen 9 seconds; half of observers missed it)

Noba Project, 'Failures of Awareness: The Case of Inattentional Blindness' by Daniel Simons: https://opentext.ku.edu/teams/chapter/inattentional-blindness (definition: failure to notice an unexpected object when attention is focused elsewhere; limits of attention; half missed the gorilla; nine seconds on screen)

Smithsonian Magazine, 'But Did You See the Gorilla?': https://www.smithsonianmag.com/science-nature/but-did-you-see-the-gorilla-the-problem-with-inattentional-blindness-17339778/ (half the viewers missed it; chest thump)
Scientific American, 'How Blind Are We?': https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/how-blind-are-we/ (about 50 percent fail to notice the gorilla)

lines.text: चैलेंज! गिनिए, लाल टीम आपस में गेंद कितनी बार पास करती है?
नज़र गेंद पर रखिए, एक भी पास मत छोड़िए!
जवाब है सात! लेकिन क्या आपने बीच से जाता पेंगुइन देखा?
lines.caps: the answer is *seven! | but did you | see the *penguin?

lines.text: एक मशहूर प्रयोग में, लगभग आधे लोगों को गोरिल्ला दिखा ही नहीं!
lines.caps: in a famous *experiment | about *half | the viewers | never saw a *gorilla!

lines.text: गोरिल्ला सूट वाला इंसान नौ सेकंड स्क्रीन पर रहा, छाती भी ठोकी!
lines.caps: a person in | a *gorilla suit | was on screen | for *nine seconds | and even *thumped | their chest!

lines.text: वजह? ध्यान सीमित है, टॉर्च की तरह: जिधर रोशनी, वही नज़र आए।
lines.caps: why? *attention | is limited | like a *torch, | we notice | what it *lights

lines.text: अब सच बताइए, पेंगुइन दिखा था या नहीं? कमेंट में लिखिए!
lines.caps: be honest: | penguin, *yes or *no? | tell us in the *comments
